After Effects · Lottie · Motion

Video and Animation

Motion, app-store previews and animated product moments created to explain, market and energize live-shopping products.

Project typeMotion Design
ContributionMotion + Creative Direction
YearSelected work
CompanyGravy

Motion that explains and energizes

During my time with Gravy I spent a ton of time creating videos and ads to help explain the core functionality of the app and to help drive downloads. A majority of my work was done using After Effects and Audition.

Using the power of Airbnb’s Lottie, After Effects and Bodymovin, I also animated various elements and characters to help breathe life into the app. These are tools I’ve become very familiar with and enjoy using.

01 · Product preview

Gravy App Store Preview

The challenge was to create a new app store preview video that could also be used as a promo or demo for prospective brands and influencers. Not only did I need to showcase live footage, but I also needed to highlight and explain unique features of the app without a voiceover or captions.

Tools used After Effects, Sketch, Audition, Photoshop

02 · Show opener

It’s Gravy Time Intro

Before each show went live, we ran a 15-second hype video to excite the audience. The goal of the clip was to make it quick, memorable and fun to watch.

Tools used After Effects, Sketch, Audition

03 · Campaign

Facebook Ad Spot

We needed a Facebook ad that left you feeling like everyone was winning cash on this hot new app and you’d be a fool not to download and give it a try. The challenge was to highlight a collage of real people’s reactions and show them quickly, all while teasing the app.

Tools used After Effects, Sketch, Audition, Photoshop

04 · Campaign

Facebook Ad Spot 2

The goal of this particular ad was to showcase the core functionality of the app in a quick 15-second clip. The voiceover narrative helps guide the explanation and keeps the clip moving along nicely.

Tools used After Effects, Sketch, Audition, Photoshop

In-product motion

Surprise and delight makes all the difference

Lightweight animations gave the Gravy experience personality and turned everyday moments into something worth celebrating.
